```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Test Investigation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number to test'
        required: true
        type: number
      test_filter:
        description: 'Test file or pattern to run (e.g., create_integration_upload.test.ts)'
        required: false
        default: 'create_integration_upload'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  run-flaky-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}/merge

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          yarn kbn bootstrap --quiet || true
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run specific unit tests for Fleet Integration Upload
        env:
          TEST_FILTER: ${{ github.event.inputs.test_filter }}
        run: |
          yarn test:jest --testPathPattern="$TEST_FILTER" --testNamePattern="loading|disabled|button" --verbose

      - name: Check for test failures
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Tests failed. This may indicate the flaky behavior or regression in the fix for disabling the upload button."

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: always()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          TEST_FILTER: ${{ github.event.inputs.test_filter }}
          JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = process.env.PR_NUMBER;
            const testFilter = process.env.TEST_FILTER;
            const jobStatus = process.env.JOB_STATUS;
            
            const output = `## Flaky Test Investigation Result
            - **PR**: #${prNumber}
            - **Test Filter**: \`${testFilter}\`
            - **Status**: ${jobStatus}
            
            This workflow was triggered to investigate the fix for disabling the 'Add to Elastic' button during custom integration package installation.
            `;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: parseInt(prNumber, 10),
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: output
            });
```
